tiers.common: humble starting-class version: plain cloth or leather, muted colours, no magic effects, a hint of the class to come
tiers.rare: seasoned class hero: fitted armour or robes with teal accents, one signature item, faint teal glow
tiers.epic: elite arcane form: ornate gear with violet/magenta accents, visible magic (runes, glowing eyes or aura), dramatic lighting
tiers.legendary: mythic ascended form: gold and white regalia, crown/halo/wings or cosmic elements, radiant golden aura, the most awe-inspiring version
